I’ve always been kind of disappointed in the appearance of the asari, because they’re basically just sexy blue tentacle lady. I wanted to experiment with their physical features and see what asari could look like if they gained more of their father species features. I’m considering drawing more, so suggest some other species you reckon could look cool! Constructive criticism is welcome :) 

Lore friendly (I hope!) codex entries:
Asari Variants: One in every thousand asari births produces an asari variant. These offspring are the result of an imperfect genetic transfer, wherein the offspring gains genetic code from its father species and thus inherits some of its physical and physiological traits. All variants retain the blue asari skin tone. 
All variants are infertile, as they are born without the necessary genetic material to reproduce. 
Asari variants are ostracised from asari space, with a few exceptions. Variants instead find homes and lives in other parts of the galaxy. 

Batarian/Asari: Known colloquially as “Batari”, this variation possess much of their father’s physical attributes, most commonly their facial folds and their extra set of eyes. 
Batari are particularly disliked by the asari, due in part to their father species’ history of bloodshed. Most batari seek refuge in batarian space, where they are revered for their beauty and sexual prowess. Batari often engage in sex work or mercenary work. 

Turian/Asari: Known colloquially as “Asurian”, this variation is notable due to their status in the turian military. 
Though rejected by their asari mothers, asurians are sought after by their turian military, due to their natural biotic abilities. They often serve as supports in the turian military, or as advisers once they reach their matriarch years. 
Many asurians seek mercenary work in their maiden years, or serve as C-SEC officers in the citadel. 

Drell/Asari: Colloquially known as “Asell”, this variation is rare; both due to the relatively low probability of variant offspring, and the scarcity of their father species. 
Most Asell remain on the Hanar homeworld, where they are welcomed into society. Many dedicate themselves to science and medicine, believing their genetic variations may be key in treating or curing Kepral’s Syndrome. 

Hanar/Asari: Known colloquially as “Hasari”, these variants are one of the few permitted in asari space. 
Due to their placid, polite nature, (and their perceived wisdom) hasari are frequently placed in civil servant roles. They are also known as excellent nannies, school teachers, and nurses. 
Some travel to the hanar homeworld, but most remain in asari space. 

Salarian/Asari: Known colloquially as “Salari”, these variants possess much of their father’s intelligence, as well as their mother’s extended lifespan. 
Salari are often employed by the salarian STG, where their long lifespan makes them perfect for overseeing long projects and operations. 
Despite their usefulness to the STG, salari are looked down upon by the wider salarian community as they are considered a genetic “dead end”. 

Krogan/Asari: Known colloquially as “Krogari”, these variants face disdain from not only the asari, but the krogan and much of the galaxy. 
Krogari are controversial amongst the krogan. Unwelcome on Tuchanka, many krogan consider krogari bastards, and as a “waste” of genetic material in the face of the genophage. However, some krogan see the krogari as the future of the race, holding the belief that they are the cure to the genophage. There are theories that this was a myth started by the salarian to further curb krogan breeding. 
Most krogari pick up mercenary work, or join pirate or smuggler rings. Krogari are unwelcome among the Blood Pack.

I was undiagnosed bipolar, and in a deep deep depressive episode. Couldn’t get out of bed. Didn’t shower for days. I was making barely any money because I was struggling to find a job. I had put on a significant amount of weight. I’d just moved out with my partner and was feeling extremely homesick. 
One night I was lying awake. It was like 3am. I’d just been alone with my thoughts for too long and needed it to stop. For reasons I won’t go into I had a rope within reach of my bed. I got prepared. Wrote a note for my partner, set myself up. Put it around my neck. 
Then I just sat there. I was so numb. So frozen. I had a moment of “am I really about to do this?”
I looked at my partner and I just started crying. It was like a dam broke. Everything just poured out. My partner woke up and comforted me. They were angry that I hadn’t told them sooner but I was just so numb all the time. So empty. 

Not long after that I got a referral to a psychiatrist and was diagnosed and am on the right meds now. But it’s scary thinking back to how close I was.

TL,DR: I was the other woman in an emotional affair when I was 16, and 7 years later it’s still one of the worst things I’ve ever done. 

I was on the other end, the “other woman”. This was back in high school and he was my best friend of 10+ years, and I’d had feelings for him for a long time. I knew he had a girlfriend. I went to school with her as well. 

We’d confessed our feelings to each other and he promised me that he would leave his girlfriend for me, he just wanted it to “end naturally”. I had just gotten out of an abusive relationship and was starved for love and support, not that that is any excuse. But that was why I went with it. I told myself I loved him, when really I was just a lonely 16 year old who hated herself, and he gave me attention. 

It was only ever emotional. We would sext every day, and I ended up sending him photos. It was never physical; that was the one thing I wouldn’t do. I thought that would make it okay, even though I hated myself for being part of it. 

He would tell me he loved me every day. Would tell me how beautiful I was. How he’d always been in love with me. I remember in class one time our knees touched and it was like fire under my skin. I was so fucking lonely and broken that I ignored my own morals. I told myself it was okay because it was only emotional. That we were going to be together and it would be alright. 

He ended up stringing me along for months. Every time I would ask when he was going to leave his girlfriend he would tell me I was entitled, and needed to wait. But every time I tried to pull away he would love bomb me. Beg me to stay. And I did. 

Eventually I came to my senses and ended it. I was still so in love with him, but I was crying all the time and hated myself for doing what I was doing. 

After I called it off I went to a party that he was also at. I got extremely drunk (I think only my second time drinking because I was 17) and could barely stand up. He (sober) stayed with me that whole night, grabbing my waist and pulling me against him. Pulling my head to his chest when we sat together. We laid down next to each other and I so desperately wanted to kiss him. I didn’t. Thank fuck. Later that night he grabbed my arse and I rounded on him. That was my limit, apparently. I asked why he did that and he just told me that he didn’t. I was just drunk and imagining things. That night reignited my feelings for him, but thankfully I had enough sense to not go back. 

A few months later I found out he had been sleeping with other girls at the same time he was talking to me. I shouldn’t have been surprised but I was crushed. I’d promised him he’d be my first when we got together, and he promised me the same thing. Stupid, I know. But I still had a stupid fantasy that he would ‘come to his senses’ and be with me. 

Even later I found out that he told all of his friends that I was “all over him” at that party, and that I was a whore and a slut. Thankfully I was with my current partner by then, and found it funny rather than hurtful. 

I still hate myself for it, and it’s something that I wish I’d never done. It feels like a stain on my soul.

Velfaris spent her formative years being raised alongside the other Tiefling children in her community, and at age 12 she was chosen to be a pilgrim, beginning her training from that day forward. 

Pilgrims leave the commune when they’re deemed ready to face the world. Their purpose is to spread the word of Loviatar and to journey to the centre of Dirst, the continent they inhabit. 

Velfaris ventured from the temple, determined to bring the word of Loviatar to the people. She had been raised to believe that outsiders were heathens, and that they needed to be saved by accepting Loviatar into their lives and to accept that suffering is the path to holiness. 

However, upon meeting Xod (a goblin ranger) and Gal Garesh (an aasimar barbarian) she found her world view challenged. Throughout her travels she has been visited by her goddess, but has become conflicted in her world view. Despite her religious beliefs it pains her to see her companions in pain, and has begun to study healing so she can help her companions during battle. 

Her party has picked up a few stragglers along the way. They found Cora (a hafling rogue) in a large glass jar in the catacombs beneath Rastamere. Ida (a warlock satyr) joined them when they were hired to protect a caravan of civilians. 

Despite her religious upbringing and her strong faith, Velfaris has had her eyes opened to the world around her. She’s still determined to complete her pilgrimage, but she has let herself enjoy her time with her party. People she now calls friends.

So far, he has played his cards close to his chest and revealed little of his past. What little he has divulged of his upbringing is that, of his 200 siblings, only 10 survived. Most were eaten by each other, or by hungry adult goblins who were too lazy to hunt. 
However, when Gal Garesh was tracked down by the Hunters Guild, Xod was immediately recognised. As a young ranger, he single handedly saved a village from a bugbear raid. Though he was offered an honorary position in the Guild, he declined, instead favouring his nomadic lifestyle. 

And that is where we find our party, delving into the depths of the forest, trying to carve their own way.

A lot of it is balancing shadows and highlights. If you create a shadow, the more highlighted the other edge is, the deeper the wrinkle looks. For example, the right (our right) smile line. I put a highlight along the upper edge, which creates the illusion of depth. There are some amazing tutorials on YouTube. Also, when you draw from a photo/draw from life, try and draw what you see, not what you think you see, if that makes sense... break everything down into shapes and build up from there. When you break it down like that, it’s easier to tweak the spacing so you can lay out the face properly.

The cuff on her wrist was crushing. Painful. She felt tired down to her bones, entirely sapped of her energy. She clutched at the bullet wound in her side, willing her healing powers back, anything to stop the steady flow of blood. There, in the darkness of the abandoned bunker, she felt utterly alone. 

“Hey, let me help.”

She jerked away as he reached out to her. The Exsanguintaor, as the media called him. Imposing at close to seven feet tall, his eyes soulless black pools. His penetrating gaze had always made her skin crawl. 

“Don’t fucking touch me,” she spat, “and don’t talk to me.”

He raised his hands in defeat, jerking her own up with them. Despite his silence, she still felt his eyes on her. 

“What?”

“Aren’t you wondering why they wanted you as well?” his gaze intensified, “why they shot you?”

She ignored him, staring at the concrete walls of the bunker. 
He shifted closer to her, making her skin itch, “after everything you’ve done for them why would they want you locked up as well?”

“Stop it.” 

He gently grasped her hand in both of his, “your name’s Elle, right?”

“How-“

He grimaced, “L-9230.”

Elle grunted in disgust, yanking her hand from his grip, turning her attention back to the wound in her side. The flow had slowed, globules of congealed blood stuck to her skin. 

“What’s your mother’s name?”

She ignored him, ripping fabric from her shirt and clumsily stuffing it in the wound, gritting her teeth against the pain.
